subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support both prepared-catalog readers as public plugin SDK APIs while keeping `loadModelCatalog` as the deprecated migration bridge, or should the public boundary be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally changing a released plugin SDK contract; source-level correctness cannot decide the durable external API and removal policy.

options.title: Approve the staged SDK transition
options.body: Keep the two prepared-catalog readers public, retain the tested deprecated wrapper, and record the migration/deprecation ownership before merge.

options.title: Narrow the SDK contract first
options.body: Move one or both prepared readers behind a narrower supported facade and update bundled callers before merging the lifecycle refactor.

options.title: Pause the API portion
options.body: Split the internal lifecycle refactor from the public SDK decision if the external contract is not ready to be adopted.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged SDK transition
recommendation.body: Keep the two prepared-catalog readers public, retain the tested deprecated wrapper, and record the migration/deprecation ownership before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and its stated lifecycle/SDK compatibility design are authored and maintained by steipete, making them the best available routing candidate for the API-boundary decision.
